messages:
paul: opened a tiny PR to clarify SDK snippets for streaming + pagination across py/ts/go. I added a short retry-with-checkpoint pattern and fixed a broken docs anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/551

ivy: can you paste the compact TS example so i can check awaiting and token update?

paul: sure:

paul: ```ts
// TS compact example: resume-aware async iterator
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
import { resumeWithCheckpoint } from '@redwood/docs-utils'

const client = new Redwood()
let token = null
for await (const page of resumeWithCheckpoint(() => client.streamPages({ pageToken: token }))) {
  handlePage(page)
  token = page.nextToken ?? null
}
```

reno: looks good. please add one line noting that the checkpoint is in-memory by default and link to the Redis persistence example for cross-process resume. Also wrap the PR URL per lint.
